policy.configuration: Each native ServerConfig independently adds max_connections default 32 (nonzero) and shutdown_grace default 5s (zero allows immediate cancellation). These are separate from each existing native timeout setting.
policy.validation: New fields fail with protocol-specific io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput before acceptance/handler work. Listener and Gemini TLS acceptor are supplied by the caller; validation does not precede caller bind/acceptor construction.
policy.admission: Local JoinSet length guards acceptance before spawning. Completed but unreaped tasks conservatively retain capacity until reaped. Pausing accept subjects pending peers to OS backlog limits; no overload status/body is invented.
policy.shutdown: Prioritize shutdown, then completed joins, then accepts. Fix absolute grace deadline when shutdown is observed, drop listener, let admitted work finish until that deadline, then abort all remaining tasks and await terminal joins.
policy.cancellation: Signal shutdown and await serve for joined cleanup. Dropping serve requests child cancellation through the owned task set but cannot await termination. Async abort/grace cannot preempt synchronous handler work or undo effects already performed, including Spartan uploads.

preserved_deadlines.gemini-protocol: Existing TLS handshake and per-read timers remain at their original sites; handler/reply/close behavior unchanged.
preserved_deadlines.gopher-protocol: Existing per-read selector timing, Gopher+ request facts and native length header unchanged; handler/write/close behavior unchanged.
preserved_deadlines.finger-protocol: Existing per-read query timing, /W verbosity and valid EOF/listing behavior unchanged; handler/write/close behavior unchanged.
preserved_deadlines.nex-protocol: Existing selector read/reply write timers, bare LF behavior and opaque headerless bytes unchanged.
preserved_deadlines.spartan-protocol: Existing request/read_exact body/reply write timers, declared content length, upload refusal, native status/MIME/body and side effects unchanged.

policy.scope: Per-listener accepted-task policy only. No common transaction deadline or new generic runtime/framework, global memory/traffic quota, per-peer limit or product residency policy.

coverage.native: Actual localhost TLS for Gemini and TCP for all plaintext protocols qualify handler-backed admission barriers, held capacity/queued next request, exact graceful response bytes, forced/zero-grace handler cancellation and observed peer closure. Gemini additionally holds native TLS handshake using ClientHello/ServerHello.
coverage.protocol_facts: Gemini status/MIME/body; Gopher+ selector/search/form and length-prefixed binary body; Finger verbose query and exact bytes; Nex bare-LF selector and opaque bytes; Spartan host/path/declared body and exact status/MIME/body with retained submission effect.
coverage.controlled: Paused-time tasks use explicit starts/drop guards, graceful/pending children, controlled panics, exact fixed grace and already-expired drain polling. Peer close accepts native EOF/reset/abort outcomes; a timeout is not closure.
coverage.limits: Native in-process supplier TCP/TLS, not independent remote readers, installed CLI signals, headed product UI, radio or separate machines. Shutdown grace is a graceful opportunity, not hard preemption of synchronous code. Existing native per-I/O timing is intentionally not promoted to a whole-operation server deadline.
